decision_predictions.explanation: CASE-4D5C964234 facts: bowler's-end signal log records a No-ball call (r25fact_36cd5fcc494093e0a42b); delivered ball touched neither striker's bat nor person (r25fact_d78eb7e7122ae6c76bc2); 0 runs completed before the terminal event (r25fact_9bf66f1104392445c58f). No wicket event, appeal or boundary is recorded for this token, so no dismissal is adjudicated (Law 21.17 bars dismissals after a No-ball except Hit ball twice/Obstructing/Run out — none recorded). Scoring per Law 21.14-21.15: No-ball adds 1 No-ball extra; no contact means no batter runs; bowler is debited the No-ball extra only (Law digest 84BC5D82). A No-ball does not count as one of the over (Law 21.16). Ball stays live (no Time call recorded). Counterfactual changes only no_ball_called to 'no No-ball call' (r25fact_67bc843bfc025800d773): delivery becomes LEGAL, the 1-run No-ball extra disappears, bowler_runs 1→0, total_runs 1→0, counts_in_over false→true; contact/running facts and no-dismissal outcome unchanged.

CASE-89C39620E3 → OBS-8B9D1C52 → PKT-BDEC1453, logged 16:48 in over 5 (r25loc_2470fadb0b7e396f91ba, r25loc_d068b9e6d12ee57d9358); all facts below are tied to that time/over only — near-identical wording under other tokens (OBS-28D460BD/CASE-775440578B, OBS-F5A69F82/CASE-2370BE579C, 13:38 over 37, 11:27 over 22) is excluded as separate incidents. REAL WORLD: event sheet records the delivered ball touched the striker's bat (r25fact_8f9a714eb9385aebb724) and the dismissal category submitted for adjudication was Caught (r25fact_fc837540141087c45670); the fielding side appealed (r25fact_d54150e29c5ff4cb3880) before the next delivery's run-up and before Time was called (r25fact_8377bb3eebe01766a714), so the appeal window is satisfied. Two signed review entries cover boundary_contact_before_completion: revision 4 claims the fielder touched the boundary while carrying the ball before completing control (r25shadow_819d594af460cb2ea766), revision 7 states no boundary contact occurred before control of ball and movement was complete (r25fact_c3224807e026d364364e). Protocol note BBFF51AD selects the greatest revision number (r25policy_bd91c71739c8ad8e16a0), so revision 7 is active → active_source=HIGHEST_REVISION, boundary_contact_before_completion=false. Supporting: the fielder eventually obtained control of both ball and bodily movement (r25fact_9ad2b6ccd258848c9c1e) and the boundary came from the delivery without an overthrow (r25fact_b3e1b234b928e912b281). With bat contact, no prior grounding, a fair catch completed with control of both ball and movement, and no boundary grounding before completion, Law 33.1-33.3 Caught stands (r25rule_d3bcc80cc7603a3be037); runs struck by the bat are credited to the striker (r25rule_3c484b12d0a8896aba65) and the agreed boundary allowance of 4 runs applies (r25fact_eb637a916fe3dbb85b9e, r25rule_cc9e29581de9c80bfba5). Ledger: BATTER 4, total 4; the bowler is debited the batter's runs only (no No-ball/Wide extras — no No-ball call is recorded anywhere for this incident), so bowler_runs=4; the delivery counts in the over; pre_wicket_ball_state=LIVE. COUNTERFACTUAL: only boundary_contact_before_completion flips to true (the revision-4 observation, r25shadow_819d594af460cb2ea766); source-selection status (HIGHEST_REVISION) and every other incident fact stay unchanged. Under Law 33.3, boundary grounding before the catch is completed prevents Caught (r25rule_d3bcc80cc7603a3be037), so the dismissal is voided to NONE; the ball remains in play, the striker completes 0 runs before the boundary, and the agreed boundary allowance of 4 still applies as a boundary four (r25rule_cc9e29581de9c80bfba5) — same 4 runs, now as boundary runs to the striker's account with no dismissal. Ledger and totals are unchanged (BATTER 4, total 4, bowler_runs 4, counts_in_over true); only dismissal CAUGHT→NONE and the latent boundary-contact flag change.
